meta.title: SSO / SAML 2.0: user login attempt on Procol
gaps: Configure or verify the tenant's SSO/SAML 2.0 integration parameters and role mapping.
Cause a user login through the configured external IdP using SAML 2.0.
Compare email, name, roles, department, and entity between Procol and the external identity provider.
Verify that no integration error was recorded in the external system.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure or verify the tenant's SSO/SAML 2.0 integration parameters and role mapping.; Cause a user login through the configured external IdP using SAML 2.0.; Compare email, name, roles, department, and entity between Procol and the external identity provider.; Verify that no integration error was recorded in the external system.

args.need: configure the SAML 2.0 inbound integration, perform a user login through the configured IdP, compare email, name, roles, department, and entity in Procol and the external system, and verify that no integration error was recorded

steps.note: The catalog cannot configure or exercise SAML/SSO or inspect the external identity provider, so tester intervention is required.
Closest available assertion for the Procol side after the tester's workflow; it does not verify the SSO exchange or external-system comparison.
